CONTENT
COMMENTS
BEST
MINE
NOTES
Read a description of a situation. Then write an e-mail about the situation. You will have 9 minutes. You should aim to write at 50-120 words. Write using complete sentences.
ITEM TEXT
You
and
your
friends
had
dinner
at
a
restaurant
yesterday
.
You
think
you
left
a
bag
at
the
restaurant
.
You
tried
to
call
them
,
but
they
did
not
answer
your
phone
.
Write
an
email
to
the
restaurant
manager
.
You
should
write
between
80
and
120
words
.
Your
ideas
must
come
from
the
following
three
themes
:
1
.
Describe
your
situation
:
who
you
were
with
,
where
you
sat
,
etc
.
;
2
.
What
the
bag
looks
like
and
what
was
in
the
bag
;
3
.
Tell
them
how
to
contact
you
.
